facts.fact: Kale 熬夜盯着邮件一封接一封涌进网站邮箱。
facts.anchor: My eyes burn as I watch all of the emails come in. One after another.

facts.fact: 他难以置信对方连 password123 都没换。
facts.anchor: Fuck, this is going to be a lot. I can’t believe they didn’t bother to change the password.

facts.fact: 他写自动过滤，把邮件转进幽灵账户再交给 Sumac。
facts.anchor: I need to automatically direct these emails into a ghost account, so I can get them over to Sumac.

facts.fact: 他尝试反查网站主人的电脑，结果定位一直弹回他自己的位置。
facts.anchor: Earlier, I tried to track down the owner of this website’s computer, but it kept bouncing back to my own location.

facts.fact: 网站上留的电话连着一个一次性号码。
facts.anchor: And the phone number is connected to a burner.

facts.fact: 十六年前家族选择贪婪，而他当时并不知道自己就是关键一环。
facts.anchor: Sixteen years ago, my family decided to choose greed above the lives of others, and while I didn’t know it at the time, I was an instrumental part in it.

facts.fact: 他就是那个找到制毒公式的十四岁黑客。
facts.anchor: The fourteen-year-old hacker who found the formula to make the poison that would go on to kill...

facts.fact: 配方杀死了三个人：一位单亲妈妈、一位新婚妻子、一位父亲。
facts.anchor: A single mom. A newly married wife. A father.

facts.fact: 直到有一天他跳出代码世界，发现自己造的世界是个谎言。
facts.anchor: Until one day, I decided to step outside of numbers and coding and realized that the world I had created was a lie.

facts.fact: 新邮件里有一封来自 Reuben Roux。
Reuben 用的还是当年那个昵称。
facts.anchor: He’s using the same nickname he used back in the day.

facts.fact: 他的道德指针偏航：Reuben 想杀的人，他也想让他们死。
facts.anchor: Because if I am right… Anyone Reuben wants to kill? I want dead too.

facts.fact: 入睡时听见走廊骚动，他归咎于那对倒霉邻居。
facts.anchor: It must be those unlucky neighbors at it again.
